title: An arbitrarily high-order accurate and locally energy/entropy-stable space-time method for a class of nonlinear wave systems
summary: We present a new class of structure-preserving, arbitrarily high-order accurate space-time schemes using unstructured simplicial meshes in space for a class of nonlinear acoustic wave propagation systems, in which the nonlinearity is encoded in the constitutive relations between the state and dual variables, while the differential operators retain the standard first-order acoustic wave structure.
